description:
Anthropic streaming decoder appends content blocks via `++ [item]` and mutates the last block via `List.update_at(content, length-1, _)` on every text/thinking delta. Both walk the full spine — O(n²) cons-cell churn per response, plus O(n²) binary churn from `existing <> text` losing append-in-place optimization. This is the hottest list code in the system.

## Fix
Store the partial assistant message's content reverse-ordered (`content_rev`) so the open block lives at the head. Pattern-match `[head | rest] = content_rev` to apply deltas in O(1). Reverse once at finalize / before emitting Done.

## File
`apps/octo_pi_ai_anthropic/lib/octo_pi/ai/providers/anthropic/decoder.ex`

## Sites to rewrite
- L114 `state.message.content ++ [content_item]` (handle content_block_start) → prepend to `content_rev`.
- L237 / L251 / L263 / L277 / L318 `List.update_at(content, position, _)` (apply_delta clauses for text_delta, thinking_delta, signature_delta, input_json_delta, citation_delta — verify exact set) → `[head | rest] = content_rev; …; %{message | content_rev: [block | rest]}`.
- L291 `Enum.at(content, position)` → `hd(content_rev)` for the currently-open block.
- `index_map` may stay as a safety check but is no longer the primary lookup.

## Boundary
Pick one:
- (a) **Recommended**: flip back to forward order at finalize / before emit. Internal field is `content_rev` until then, then becomes `content`.
- (b) Keep `content_rev` internally and expose `Message.Assistant.content/1` accessor that reverses lazily.

(a) is simpler and preserves the external Message struct shape; pick that unless something forces (b).

## Tests
All scenarios in `apps/octo_pi_ai_anthropic/test/octo_pi/ai/providers/anthropic/decoder_test.exs` must pass. Add cases for:
- Multi-block response with text + thinking + tool_use interleaved (verify final order forward-correct).
- 50+ text deltas accumulated into one block (verify final concatenated string and block order).
- Out-of-order content_block_start indices (sanity).
Also re-run `apps/octo_pi_ai_anthropic/test/octo_pi/ai_stream_test.exs`. `mix format` + umbrella-wide `mix test`.

## Independence
Independent of MessageLog ticket — can land in either order.
title: Anthropic decoder: store content reverse-ordered for O(1) delta updates
